subject.title: Dashboard: export / import / share a workspace config

question: Should dashboard workspace import/export/share be sponsored as bundled dashboard plugin work after the Wave 1 stack lands, or should it be deferred or externalized first?
rationale: The feature is useful and aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it depends on an unmerged bundled dashboard surface and crosses storage, approval, sandbox, and shareability boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Sponsor After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 4 distribution item and require storage, security, API, and upgrade proof when the prerequisite dashboard stack is ready.

options.title: Externalize First
options.body: Ask contributors to prove workspace package import/export as an external plugin or ClawHub package until maintainers accept bundled dashboard scope.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Sharing
options.body: Leave the roadmap child open but do not queue implementation until the base dashboard and custom-widget approval flow are accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 4 distribution item and require storage, security, API, and upgrade proof when the prerequisite dashboard stack is ready.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and bundled Logbook precedent that this dashboard work builds on.
